bdsg.muc_dich: Chay tren may ca nhan, CPU. Day la cau hinh mac dinh de nguoi dung tai ve.

tham_so_uoc_tinh.trang_thai: TINH TOAN, CHUA DO. Chua co trong so nao ton tai (25/09/2026).
tham_so_uoc_tinh.cach_tinh: Xem huan-luyen/cau-hinh/tinh_tham_so.py. Cong thuc doi chieu voi bang tham so trong README_en.md cua MiniMind: cau hinh 768/8/kv4/vocab6400 ra 63.91M, ho ghi 64M; cau hinh MoE 4 chuyen gia ra 198.42M-A63.94M, ho ghi 198M-A64M. Sai so duoi 0.2% nen cong thuc duoc coi la dung.

vi_sao_chon_so_nay: hidden_size=512 va 8 lop: dung lai dung kich thuoc minimind2-small (26M o vocab 6400) vi day la cau hinh duy nhat trong ho MiniMind da co bang chung chay duoc that. BDSG khong phat minh kich thuoc moi o ban dau.
intermediate_size=1664 la ket qua cong thuc mac dinh cua MiniMind: ceil(512*pi/64)*64. Ghi ro ra day de khong phu thuoc vao gia tri mac dinh cua thu vien.
head_dim=64 = hidden_size/num_attention_heads, dung mac dinh cua MiniMindConfig.
vocab_size=24576: BAT BUOC giong het hai cau hinh con lai. Ly do o README muc 3.
canh_bao: vocab_size PHAI khop voi tu vung that sinh ra tu huan-luyen/tu-vung/huan_luyen_tu_vung.py. Neu lech, embedding tra ve loi chi so ngay batch dau.
trainer/train_pretrain.py dong 108 va trainer/train_full_sft.py dong 109 KHONG truyen vocab_size vao MiniMindConfig, nen mo hinh se lang le lay mac dinh 6400. Phai va hai dong do. Xem README muc 6.
